name: Iwate

flag.description: A white emblem on a dark blue-green field: the kanji 岩 (iwa, "rock") drawn symmetrically top to bottom and side to side.
flag.symbolism: The character 岩 begins the prefecture's name, drawn to show a prefecture leaping forward.

hook: Iwate's white emblem is the kanji 岩 (iwa, "rock"), squared off so it reads the same upside down and in a mirror.
trivia: Iwate is the second-largest prefecture after Hokkaido.
Hiraizumi, once the seat of the Northern Fujiwara clan, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
